<documents>
<document id="transfers-cancel">
CancellingˆaˆtransferˆWhetherˆyouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆdependsˆonˆtheˆtypeˆofˆtransferˆandˆhowˆfarˆalongˆitˆis.ˆ##ˆScheduledˆorˆpendingˆACHˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆACHˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆuntilˆtheˆACHˆcutoffˆtimeˆ(4:00ˆPMˆET)ˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆtransferˆandˆtapˆCancel.ˆAfterˆtheˆcutoff,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆalreadyˆonˆitsˆwayˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆarriveˆinstantlyˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆWiresˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆWeˆcanˆaskˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney,ˆbutˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆdecides,ˆandˆitˆisn'tˆguaranteed.ˆ##ˆRecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆstopˆfutureˆtransfersˆinˆaˆrecurringˆseriesˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStoppingˆtheˆseriesˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆthat'sˆalreadyˆpastˆitsˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆSentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆaccount?ˆIfˆanˆACHˆtransferˆwentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆexternalˆaccount,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆtryˆtoˆcontactˆtheˆotherˆbank,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆback.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-ach-cutoff-v2">
ACHˆtransferˆcutoffˆtimesˆStandardˆtransfersˆtoˆandˆfromˆyourˆlinkedˆbankˆaccountsˆuseˆACH,ˆwhichˆonlyˆprocessesˆonˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆtimeˆTransfersˆyouˆsubmitˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆthatˆday.ˆTransfersˆsubmittedˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆorˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆbankˆholiday,ˆareˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆOnceˆsent,ˆACHˆtransfersˆusuallyˆarriveˆinˆ1ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆTheˆotherˆbankˆdecidesˆwhenˆtoˆmakeˆtheˆmoneyˆavailable.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆyouˆsendˆmoneyˆonˆaˆFridayˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆit'sˆsentˆonˆMondayˆ(orˆTuesdayˆifˆMondayˆisˆaˆholiday).ˆ##ˆFasterˆoptionsˆ-ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆTallowbrookˆmembersˆarriveˆinˆseconds,ˆeveryˆday.ˆ-ˆDomesticˆwiresˆarriveˆtheˆsameˆbusinessˆdayˆifˆsentˆbeforeˆtheˆwireˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆDailyˆandˆmonthlyˆACHˆlimitsˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆSeeˆtheˆtransferˆlimitsˆarticleˆforˆyourˆplan.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-pending">
Whyˆisˆmyˆtransferˆpending?ˆAˆtransferˆcanˆshowˆasˆpendingˆforˆaˆfewˆreasons.ˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆtellˆwhat'sˆgoingˆon.ˆ##ˆWaitingˆforˆtheˆcutoffˆACHˆtransfersˆsubmittedˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆorˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆstayˆpendingˆuntilˆthey'reˆsentˆonˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆOnˆitsˆwayˆOnceˆsent,ˆACHˆtransfersˆtakeˆ1ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆarrive.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆexpectedˆarrivalˆdateˆonˆtheˆtransfer.ˆ##ˆUnderˆreviewˆSomeˆtransfersˆareˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆlargeˆfirstˆtransferˆtoˆaˆnewlyˆlinkedˆaccount.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆ"Inˆreview".ˆReviewsˆusuallyˆfinishˆwithinˆoneˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆwe'llˆmessageˆyouˆifˆweˆneedˆanything.ˆ##ˆNewˆdeviceˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆtransfersˆaboveˆ$500ˆcan'tˆbeˆsent.ˆ##ˆIncomingˆtransfersˆIfˆmoneyˆsentˆtoˆyouˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆcheckˆwithˆtheˆsender'sˆbankˆwhenˆitˆwasˆsent.ˆDirectˆdepositsˆusuallyˆarriveˆasˆsoonˆasˆyourˆemployer'sˆpaymentˆfileˆreachesˆus.ˆIfˆaˆtransferˆhasˆbeenˆpendingˆlongerˆthanˆtheˆexpectedˆarrivalˆdate,ˆmessageˆsupportˆwithˆtheˆamountˆandˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What's the cutoff time for ACH transfers?
